text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"On the eve of the NHK Mile Cup, Rhein 
Kraft visits Tokyo Racecourse at night. 
There, she encounters Daring Heart."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft asked Daring Heart why she 
decided to take on the challenge of the 
NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart's goal was supposed to be the 
Triple Tiara. Why, then, did she choose 
the NHK Mile Cup?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart reveals her single reason— it 
was because she admired Rhein Kraft, who 
was striving to blaze an untrodden path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to those words, Rheingraft truly 
believed she could grasp a radiance 
uniquely her own. And so, the day of the 
NHK Mile Cup arrived—
